page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge delivers modest performance. Its single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng, falls into the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, single-threaded gzip compression is poor, ranking in the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average capabilities in PassMark CPU tests and extended instruction sets. Memory bandwidth performance is mixed; while small-block cached reads are weak, large-block uncached reads and writes achieve average tier performance. For lightweight LLM inference tasks using a small 135M model, the instance achieves average speeds, though performance drops significantly to the bottom 10% when running larger 7B models.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio, the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge offers a stable but legacy hardware profile. It is qualitatively positioned as a budget-friendly option for workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without the premium cost of newer architecture generations. The lack of local storage and modest database and Redis benchmark results make it less suitable for high-throughput database systems. Instead, this instance is best suited for general-purpose applications, basic web serving, development environments, and lightweight background processing tasks.
